description: global_config.updateEdgeConfig (PUT /v1/global-config/{edgeConfigId}) has the same query-vs-body `slug` collision as createEdgeConfig: the required body property `slug` (the new config name) is dropped from UpdateEdgeConfigRequest, leaving the rename operation with no way to send its only body field (live-verified: PUT with body slug 200s and renames). Remove the redundant `slug` query parameter so the body property survives flattening.
